mapping_note: Direct mappings cover acceptance of Time Advance Request and request completion through Time Advance Grant (8.8.3), plus the grant's honored target time (8.14.3). Disable/enable callback suppression and release and callback-model-specific servicing are supplemental public-API checks; no time-advance-specific callback-control candidate is claimed. Time-role setup and cleanup are controls.
notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for callback enable and disable around standard time-management callbacks. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, logical-time implementation, and callback configuration. It verifies time-regulation and time-constrained setup, suppression and release of timeAdvanceGrant, exact target-time metadata, callback-model servicing, and federation cleanup without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador callback enable/disable and callback-servicing controls with enableTimeRegulation/enableTimeConstrained/timeAdvanceRequest and FederateAmbassador timeRegulationEnabled/timeConstrainedEnabled/timeAdvanceGrant delivery
